paragraphs.text: translated by
1. FIRST Agni sprang to life from out of Heaven: the second time from us came Jatavedas.
paragraphs.original: दिवस्परि प्रथमं जज्ञे अग्निरस्मद्द्वितीयं परि जातवेदाः ।
paragraphs.translit: divaspari prathamaṃ jajñe agnirasmaddvitīyaṃ pari jātavedāḥ |

paragraphs.text: Thirdly the Manly-souled was in the waters. The pious lauds and kindles him the Eternal.
paragraphs.original: तृतीयमप्सु नृमणा अजस्रमिन्धान एनं जरते स्वाधीः
paragraphs.translit: tṛtīyamapsu nṛmaṇā ajasramindhāna enaṃ jarate svādhīḥ

paragraphs.text: 2. Agni, we know thy three powers in three stations, we know thy forms in many a place divided.
paragraphs.original: विद्मा ते अग्ने त्रेधा त्रयाणि विद्मा ते धाम विभृता पुरुत्रा ।
paragraphs.translit: vidmā te agne tredhā trayāṇi vidmā te dhāma vibhṛtā purutrā |

paragraphs.text: We know what name supreme thou hast in secret: we know the source from which thou hast proceeded.
paragraphs.original: विद्मा ते नाम परमं गुहा यद्विद्मा तमुत्सं यत आजगन्थ
paragraphs.translit: vidmā te nāma paramaṃ guhā yadvidmā tamutsaṃ yata ājagantha

paragraphs.text: 3. The Manly-souled lit thee in sea and waters, man's Viewer lit thee in the breast of heaven,
paragraphs.original: समुद्रे त्वा नृमणा अप्स्वन्तर्नृचक्षा ईधे दिवो अग्न ऊधन् ।
paragraphs.translit: samudre tvā nṛmaṇā apsvantarnṛcakṣā īdhe divo agna ūdhan |

paragraphs.text: There as thou stoodest in the third high region the Steers increased thee in the water's bosom.
paragraphs.original: तृतीये त्वा रजसि तस्थिवांसमपामुपस्थे महिषा अवर्धन्
paragraphs.translit: tṛtīye tvā rajasi tasthivāṃsamapāmupasthe mahiṣā avardhan

paragraphs.text: 4. Agni roared out, like Dyaus what time he thunders: he licked the ground about the plants he flickered.
paragraphs.original: अक्रन्ददग्नि स्तनयन्निव द्यौः क्षामा रेरिहद्वीरुधः समञ्जन् ।
paragraphs.translit: akrandadagni stanayanniva dyauḥ kṣāmā rerihadvīrudhaḥ samañjan |

paragraphs.text: At once, when born, he looked around enkindled, and lightened heaven and earth within with splendour.
paragraphs.original: सद्यो जज्ञानो वि हीमिद्धो अख्यदा रोदसी भानुना भात्यन्तः
paragraphs.translit: sadyo jajñāno vi hīmiddho akhyadā rodasī bhānunā bhātyantaḥ

paragraphs.text: 5. The spring of glories and support of riches, rouser of thoughts and guardian of the Soma,
paragraphs.original: श्रीणामुदारो धरुणो रयीणां मनीषाणां प्रार्पणः सोमगोपाः ।
paragraphs.translit: śrīṇāmudāro dharuṇo rayīṇāṃ manīṣāṇāṃ prārpaṇaḥ somagopāḥ |

paragraphs.text: Good Son of Strength, a King amid the waters, in forefront of the Dawns he shines enkindled.
paragraphs.original: वसुः सूनुः सहसो अप्सु राजा वि भात्यग्र उषसामिधानः
paragraphs.translit: vasuḥ sūnuḥ sahaso apsu rājā vi bhātyagra uṣasāmidhānaḥ

paragraphs.text: 6. Germ of the world, ensign of all creation, be sprang to life and filled the earth and heavens.
paragraphs.original: विश्वस्य केतुर्भुवनस्य गर्भ आ रोदसी अपृणाज्जायमानः ।
paragraphs.translit: viśvasya keturbhuvanasya garbha ā rodasī apṛṇājjāyamānaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Even the firm rock he cleft when passing over, when the Five Tribes brought sacrifice to Agni.
paragraphs.original: वीळुं चिदद्रिमभिनत्परायञ्जना यदग्निमयजन्त पञ्च
paragraphs.translit: vīḷuṃ cidadrimabhinatparāyañjanā yadagnimayajanta pañca

paragraphs.text: 7. So among mortals was Immortal Agni stablished as holy wise and willing envoy.
paragraphs.original: उशिक्पावको अरतिः सुमेधा मर्तेष्वग्निरमृतो नि धायि ।
paragraphs.translit: uśikpāvako aratiḥ sumedhā marteṣvagniramṛto ni dhāyi |

paragraphs.text: He waves the red smoke that he lifts above him, striving to reach the heavens with radiant lustre.
paragraphs.original: इयर्ति धूममरुषं भरिभ्रदुच्छुक्रेण शोचिषा द्यामिनक्षन्
paragraphs.translit: iyarti dhūmamaruṣaṃ bharibhraducchukreṇa śociṣā dyāminakṣan

paragraphs.text: 8. Like gold to look on, far he shone refulgent, beaming imperishable life for glory,
paragraphs.original: दृशानो रुक्म उर्विया व्यद्यौद्दुर्मर्षमायुः श्रिये रुचानः ।
paragraphs.translit: dṛśāno rukma urviyā vyadyauddurmarṣamāyuḥ śriye rucānaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Agni by vital powers became immortal when his prolific Father Dyaus begat him.
paragraphs.original: अग्निरमृतो अभवद्वयोभिर्यदेनं द्यौर्जनयत्सुरेताः
paragraphs.translit: agniramṛto abhavadvayobhiryadenaṃ dyaurjanayatsuretāḥ

paragraphs.text: 9. Whoso this day, O God whose flames are lovely, prepares a cake, O Agni, mixt with butter,
paragraphs.original: यस्ते अद्य कृणवद्भद्रशोचेऽपूपं देव घृतवन्तमग्ने ।
paragraphs.translit: yaste adya kṛṇavadbhadraśoce'pūpaṃ deva ghṛtavantamagne |

paragraphs.text: Lead thou and further him to higher fortune, to bliss bestowed by Gods, O thou Most Youthful.
paragraphs.original: प्र तं नय प्रतरं वस्यो अच्छाभि सुम्नं देवभक्तं यविष्ठ
paragraphs.translit: pra taṃ naya prataraṃ vasyo acchābhi sumnaṃ devabhaktaṃ yaviṣṭha

paragraphs.text: 10. Endow him, Agni, with a share of glory, at every song of praise sung forth enrich him.
paragraphs.original: आ तं भज सौश्रवसेष्वग्न उक्थउक्थ आ भज शस्यमाने ।
paragraphs.translit: ā taṃ bhaja sauśravaseṣvagna ukthauktha ā bhaja śasyamāne |

paragraphs.text: Dear let him be to Surya, dear to Agni, preeminent with son and children's children.
paragraphs.original: प्रियः सूर्ये प्रियो अग्ना भवात्युज्जातेन भिनददुज्जनित्वैः
paragraphs.translit: priyaḥ sūrye priyo agnā bhavātyujjātena bhinadadujjanitvaiḥ

paragraphs.text: 11. While, Agni, day by day men pay thee worship they win themselves all treasures worth the wishing.
paragraphs.original: त्वामग्ने यजमाना अनु द्यून्विश्वा वसु दधिरे वार्याणि ।
paragraphs.translit: tvāmagne yajamānā anu dyūnviśvā vasu dadhire vāryāṇi |

paragraphs.text: Allied with thee, eager and craving riches, they have disclosed the stable filled with cattle.
paragraphs.original: त्वया सह द्रविणमिच्छमाना व्रजं गोमन्तमुशिजो वि वव्रुः
paragraphs.translit: tvayā saha draviṇamicchamānā vrajaṃ gomantamuśijo vi vavruḥ

paragraphs.text: 12. Agni, the Friend of men, the Soma's keeper, Vaisvanara, hath been lauded by the Rsis.
paragraphs.original: अस्ताव्यग्निर्नरां सुशेवो वैश्वानर ऋषिभिः सोमगोपाः ।
paragraphs.translit: astāvyagnirnarāṃ suśevo vaiśvānara ṛṣibhiḥ somagopāḥ |

paragraphs.text: We will invoke benignant Earth and Heaven: ye Deities, give us wealth with hero children.
paragraphs.original: अद्वेषे द्यावापृथिवी हुवेम देवा धत्त रयिमस्मे सुवीरम्
paragraphs.translit: adveṣe dyāvāpṛthivī huvema devā dhatta rayimasme suvīram
